description: Portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe standing in the corner of her Abiquiu house studio looking towards the window. She is wearing a white long sleeved collared jacket over a white collared shirt, silver hand-hammered dome button / pin at the neck, and a broomstick-style skirt with arms folded across torso at waist. Paint brushes and gesso canvases visible on windowsill.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe
